title: ZionDesk — 30s launch
voiceDirection: Energetic, warm, confident male voice with a light Nigerian (West African) accent; clear, upbeat product-launch delivery, smiling, not shouting.

lines.text: Pastor, your calling is people — not paperwork.
Every member, every family, every first-time guest — in one place.
Track tithes and offerings, and receive giving online, in your own currency.
Reach your church on WhatsApp and email — in five languages.
Run services on Google Meet, and create stunning flyers with AI, in seconds.
And Ellen, your AI assistant, keeps every ministry moving.
ZionDesk. Church management, made simple. Try it free today.
